top_signals.title: S&P 500 Advances as Nvidia, Tech Outweigh Broad Weakness
top_signals.summary: Technology stocks rallied Thursday on a blockbuster outlook from Nvidia Corp. lifting key equity indexes, while every other sector in the US stock market fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Gap shares jump 9% after company names new Old Navy CEO to revive struggling brand
top_signals.summary: Gap announced a new CEO for Old Navy on Thursday as the brand reported a decline in comparable sales for the most recent quarter.
